'''Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209''' was a squadron of Imperial cargo ships tasked with supplying forces assigned to the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] during the years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the battles of [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Yavin]] and [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

By far the largest ship attached to DK-209 was the enormous 7,800m [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessel]] ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'', but the fleet also included six [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]], ''[[Cargo I]]'', ''[[Cargo IV]]'', ''[[Colo's Ship]]'', ''[[Fasan]]'', ''[[Star Bantha]]'' and ''[[Talsor]]'', three [[Maintenance Carrier]]s, ''[[FarRun]]'', [[Fixer (Maintenance Carrier)|''Fixer'']] and ''[[Quartermain III]]'', and two [[Container ship/Legends|container ships]], [[Bounty (container ship)|''Bounty'']] and ''[[Cargo X]]''.

Protection for the fleet was provided by three [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]], [[Guardian (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Guardian'']], ''[[Protector II]]'', and ''[[Security I]]'', and a group of five [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]], named as ''[[Lancer I]]'' through ''[[Lancer V]]''.

Shortly after the destruction of the Alliance's main fuel dump in the sector, Rebel operatives discovered that Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209 was traveling along [[hyperlane GG734]] to the [[Refrax Spaceport]], where the ''Black Ice'' was due to take on a cargo of starship power cells, and several of the escorts were to receive brief spacedock overhauls, before the fleet proceeded on [[hyperlane GH972]] to rendezvous with [[Assault Fleet EM4]] in the [[Kestel system/Legends|Kestel system]]. There was a delay of half a day between the FSCV completing her loading and the escorts finishing their overhauls, and the Rebels were able to take advantage of this to capture the ''Black Ice''.
